stem: Trap counts fall after treatment, but half the traps were removed at the same time. What is the best conclusion?
choices: Sampling effort changed, so the apparent decline is confounded and should not be credited without adjustment or comparable follow-up.
Removed traps count as zero catches.
The earlier round should be discarded.
rationale: Sampling effort changed, so the apparent decline is confounded and should not be credited without adjustment or comparable follow-up.
